title: Ohio court overturns divorce deal after husband alleges wife hid $443,000 in personal spending
summary_full: An Ohio businessman, Jason G. Jardine, successfully appealed a divorce settlement ruling due to undisclosed expenditures by his ex-wife, Crystal T. Jardine. The Ohio Court of Appeals determined that the original decision lacked a hearing concerning fraud allegations. Jason claimed Crystal obtained significant undocumented funds during their divorce, complicating their dispute over funeral home management and associated receiver fees. The court has mandated further hearings to address these financial matters.
